sources.title: Soulfate24/AutoRound-ASHQ1-Remix_Double-Quantization_Suite - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AutoRound & ASHQ1-Remix Suite Version 2.3.0 — Activation-aware GGUF quantization whose every ratio, floor, and cap traces to a measured experiment. Plain-BF16-native first; AutoRound lineage supported with explicit saturation bounds. Full seven-tier ladder validated across six model families.

sources.title: AutoRound + ASHQ1 Double-Quantization Suite - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The AutoRound + ASHQ1 Suite delivers a complete pipeline for creating ultra-high-fidelity GGUF models. By combining gradient-guided weight reorganization (AutoRound W4A16) with fine-grained activation-aware tensor assignment (ASHQ1 Imatrix Engine), this suite establishes a new standard for low-bit LLM compression.

sources.snippet: AutoRound is an advanced quantization toolkit designed for Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs). It achieves high accuracy at ultra-low bit widths (2-4 bits) with minimal tuning by leveraging sign-gradient descent and providing broad hardware compatibility.

sources.title: Quantization Schemes | intel/auto-round | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document explains quantization schemes in AutoRound, which define how model weights and activations are quantized. A quantization scheme specifies parameters such as bit-width, group size, symmetry, and data type. AutoRound provides preset schemes (like W4A16, MXFP4, GGUF:Q4_K_M) that can be used directly or customized per-layer.
